result.reasoning: This commit introduced the `isMounted` AtomicBoolean and the buggy `shutdown()` logic where `isMounted.set(NativeMethods.DokanRemoveMountPoint(...))` sets isMounted to true when unmount succeeds instead of false, causing "already unmounted" checks to misbehave (unable to unmount / wrong isMounted state). It also introduced the direct blocking call `NativeMethods.DokanMain(...)` in `start()` which the fix wraps with a CompletableFuture/timeout. Both bugs fixed in b76c93fc trace directly back to the logic added in this commit.
